text:
lydia: Quick ask  my mom is popping by at 11:30 with my 14mo niece and a stroller. Can we get a guest badge and the nursing room key? Also expecting a big gift basket today  please hold if it arrives.
front-desk: Of course. We have a private nursing room (key at desk) and a stroller parking spot by the west coat rack. Guests sign in and get a day badge. Which name for the badge?
lydia: Badge for 'Marta Gomez'. Please note stroller is compact but might need space. The gift basket is for Lydia Shaw.
reception-bot: Guest badge print queued for "Marta Gomez" at 11:22. Badge ID G-4098.
oliver: Heads-up  if the basket has perishables we put it in fridge P2; otherwise locker D4. @mailroom can you monitor deliveries?
janet: Also reminder: if bringing a stroller please fold it before entering elevator during peak times. We can hold stroller in lobby if needed.
mailroom: Noted. We received a large box labeled "Lydia Shaw - gift basket" at 10:58. It contains jars and a small bottle, marked "fragile - edible". Placed in locker D4. No leaks.
lydia: Wonderful, thank you. Could you add a sticky 'Perishable' just in case?
front-desk: Sticky note 'Perishable' added and P2 reserved if needed. We'll hand over the nursing room key when Marta checks in.
mailroom: Guest checked in at 11:31. Badge handed to Marta. Stroller parked by west coat rack. Basket handed over to Lydia after ID check; fridge not needed.
lydia: You're lifesavers  thanks everyone, especially for the nursing room key.
oliver: Glad it worked out. Also, if anyone else is dropping by with kids this month we can add a short note to the visitor form about stroller/elevator etiquette.
janet: Good idea  I can update the sign-in script.
reception-bot: Closing loop: guest flow completed at 11:35.
